points.description: Method: Correct choice and setup of analysis approach (KCL/KVL and dependent source identification).
points.partial_credit: Deduct 1 mark per error (M1, M2), up to 5 marks total.

points.description: Equation: Correct governing equations (Ohm's law, KCL/KVL signs, dependent source relation).
points.partial_credit: Deduct 1 mark per error (E1, E2, E3), up to 5 marks total.

points.description: Calculation: Correct algebraic manipulation and numerical evaluation leading to the final gain A.
points.partial_credit: Deduct 1-2 marks per error (C1, C2, C3), up to 10 marks total.

points.description: Unit: Correct and consistent use of units (gain A is dimensionless).
points.partial_credit: Deduct 0.5 marks per error (U1, U2), up to 2 marks total.

points.description: Completeness: Final numerical value for A is stated and linked to the circuit analysis.
points.partial_credit: Deduct 1 mark per error (NC1, NC2), up to 10 marks total.

rubric.notes: Students start with 100 marks and lose points based on specific errors identified in the rubric. Full marks are awarded for a complete, logically sound derivation of the gain A with correct units. Partial credit is applied by subtracting the specified deductions for method, equation, calculation, unit, or completeness errors.
